nodes.label: LLM system instruction (verbatim, must appear in code)
nodes.norm_label: llm system instruction (verbatim, must appear in code)
nodes.rationale: The routing engine is the source of truth for people, credentials, projects, availability, cost, cohorts, partners and gaps. Never select entities, invent evidence, or claim a route is verified unless the exact information appears in the engine result. If the route contains a gap, explain that gap and only the next actions supplied by the engine.

nodes.label: ADR 0003 (D-06): Anthropic SDK behind an LlmAdapter interface
nodes.norm_label: adr 0003 (d-06): anthropic sdk behind an llmadapter interface
nodes.rationale: The Operator holds an Anthropic key but the product must keep working with no key at all; an adapter interface lets a second provider be added without touching orchestration.

nodes.label: Non-negotiable 3: LLM boundary enforced in code
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable 3: llm boundary enforced in code
nodes.rationale: The explanation adapter receives only the structured VentureRoute, never raw graph data (PRD §5.7); system instruction verbatim in DOMAIN.md.

nodes.label: DOMAIN LLM boundary
nodes.rationale: Permitted: extract fields, ask for missing fields, explain from the structured result, restate next actions. Forbidden: select/rank/reject/substitute, infer absent facts, route despite a gap, mutate facts, receive raw graph data.
